text.description_html:
Acorn PMH-C-05, Petronius Half Round Cabinet Knob

The Petronius Half Round Stainless Steel Cabinet Knob will look great in any setting; it is perfect for modern homes as well as traditional. The artful blending of a contemporary material with a classic half round shape that truly gives it versatility. The brushed stainless steel finish is easy to maintain so you know that these cabinet knobs will look beautiful for years to come.

Also Available Matching Petronius Cabinet Pull

Specifications of the Petronius Half Round Stainless Steel Cabinet Knob:

  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Diameter: 1-1/8"
  • Projection: 1-3/32"
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold individually.
